name: companyos-twin
description: companyOS Twin: a private, employee-owned work twin for macOS, Windows and Linux

scripts.build: npm run build -w @companyos/twin-core && npm run build -w @companyos/desktop && node apps/browser-ext/scripts/build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @companyos/twin-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/privacy/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w @companyos/twin-core && npm run test -w @companyos/desktop && node --test apps/browser-ext/test/host.test.js && node --test apps/browser-ext/test/manifest.test.mjs && node --test scripts/measure/measure.test.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @companyos/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @companyos/desktop
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run dist:dir -w @companyos/desktop
